text:
marie_cs: Post-onboard notes for BrightHarbor (embedding pilot). Positive kickoff but 3 asks + renewal concern. Sharing raw thread so product & finance can triage.

kevin_revops: drop the asks here pls. any exact language from their CFO is helpful.

marie_cs: OK: 1) route-level billing (they want to see cost per API route + per-team), 2) test/dev discounted profile (lower-cost dev usage), 3) webhook failure tracing (human-readable retry timeline). CFO note: "Invoice jumped to ~$3.7k unexpectedly in week 1. Need breakouts or we'll freeze renewal talks."

sasha_pm: this looks like a renewal risk. Quick question: do they have a lot of small requests or a few huge ones?

marie_cs: mostly small dev/test calls from multiple engineers; suspect accidental heavy usage from CI jobs. They haven't shared request IDs yet.

lia_devexp: for dev-profile: we can add a config preset that sets batch_size=1, use_low_priority_nodes=true, cache_enabled=false. We'll need to warn about latency tradeoffs. Could ship as "beta" feature flag in 1 sprint.

kevin_revops: Finance can generate an export that maps charges to route tags. Short-term we can push nightly CSV. Long-term UI visibility required.

tom_eng: webhook tracing: current logs have retries but not an aggregated timeline. Short-term: add a permalink from alert to raw log lines. Medium-term: build a retry timeline UI.

marie_cs: recommendation: P0 = per-route billing visibility (renewal at risk), P1 = manual CSV export + KB + webhook permalink, P2 = dev discount profile.

sasha_pm: agree. Action owners?

marie_cs: proposal: kevin_revops -> coordinate finance export + sample CSV; sasha_pm -> roadmap entry + stakeholder comms; lia_devexp -> prototype dev-profile; tom_eng -> quick permalink to logs. I'll handle customer communication and schedule a 48h review call with finance.

support-bot: Recording saved: https://redwood-recordings/company/4940001234/brightharbor-onboard-2026-04-05.mp4

kevin_revops: I'll get sample CSV ready by EOD tomorrow and share schema. If they can provide invoice PDF & a few request IDs that will speed mapping.

lia_devexp: I'll draft a dev-profile RFC and include sample cost deltas (estimate 50-70% lower per-request cost for tiny loads). Need product sign-off on acceptable latency increase.

marie_cs: I offered a temporary manual export + a walkthrough with finance; customer accepted and scheduled. That should alleviate immediate pressure. Updating Gainsight renewal flag after PRD.

sasha_pm: tagging product analytics and finance on the roadmap ticket. Dan (product analytics) - can you help model customer ROI if we surface per-route cost?

marie_cs: thanks everyone. Please post updates here so I can keep the CS case notes current. :thumbsup:
